The9 is a Chinese company and the first regional operator for World of Warcraft from 2005 to 2009. They partnered with Blizzard Entertainment to license World of Warcraft in mainland China where it launched on 6 June 2005. The Chinese release of on 6 September 2007 followed an eight‑month delay caused by regulatory review and a copyright dispute. The9 was required to adjust several in‑game assets to meet content standards set by the , including adding flesh to skeletal models and replacing pile of bones with gravestones. The launch was further affected by a lawsuit filed by over the unauthorized use of its proprietary fonts, prompting the removal of those fonts from the expansion. The launch

The Black Rose is a Forsaken battleship, and part of the Windrunner Fleet. The Black Rose was boarded by Commander Lorna Crowley and an adventurer during the Skyfire's attack on the Fleet in the Cove of Nashal in Stormheim. The ship operated as a seafaring laboratory of the Royal Apothecary Society, and when it sank it released one of its more volatile substances on the shores of Stormheim, which began affecting both the local wildlife and the surviving crew.

The Call of the Worldsoul is a meta quest offered by Faerin Lothar in Dornogal every third week. It presents a choice between four Worldsoul quests in Khaz Algar and automatically completes when one of the offered quests is completed. It has no rewards of its own. The other two weekly meta quests are one of the archives quests like Archives: Seeking History started by High Speaker Brinthe or Delves: Percussive Archaeology started by Brann Bronzebeard.

The Creeping Death is a Forsaken battleship, and part of the Windrunner Fleet. The Crowd Chose You!!! was an arena buff that appears in matches that ran 15 minutes long, applying to one of the teams that greatly increases their damage, critical strike chance, stealth detection, and reduces damage taken. The team that receives the buff depends on the following criteria: *Team with the largest number of players alive. *Team that brought an enemy player closest to death (lowest health by value, not percent).

"The Courageous Kobold and the Wickless Candle" is a short story by Allison Irons published in the anthology Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth. It is illustrated by Lindsey Burcar. A tale in which a young kobold ventures beyond the clan’s forbidden tunnels to rescue her cousin and reveal the truth of the mythical Wickless Candle—the sun above the surface.

The Deathless Marauder is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing Trial of Valor on Mythic Difficulty without dying as a Hunter or Shaman. It rewards the Mythic version of Ensemble: Chains of the Chosen Dead, previously exclusive to The Chosen.

The Deathless Champion is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing Trial of Valor on Mythic Difficulty without dying as a Paladin, Warrior, or Death Knight. It rewards the Mythic version of Ensemble: Funerary Plate of the Chosen Dead, previously exclusive to The Chosen.

The Empire's Reach II is an Arathi airship that continually travels on a clockwise route around central Hallowfall, docking for a few seconds at each major hub: Dunelle's Kindness, Lightspark, northern Mereldar, the Sanctified Grounds, Lorel's Crossing, and back to Dunelle's Kindness.

The Embers is an Arathi airship that continually travels counterclockwise in an oblong route above Mereldar in southwestern Hallowfall, from just west of the Veneration Grounds to the cliffs north of Beledar's Bounty. She does not dock at any point. A round trip takes 3 minutes 35 seconds.

The Eternal Palace is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the bosses of the Eternal Palace on Normal difficulty or higher.

The Eternity is a Forsaken battleship, and part of the Windrunner Fleet. When the fleet was attacked by the Skyfire in the Cove of Nashal in Stormheim, Nathanos Blightcaller and an adventurer were directed to it by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner to protect the ships.
The Emerald Nightmare is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the bosses of the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher.
The Facets of K'aresh is found at in the Oasis in K'aresh while Phase Diving. This is one of the criteria of Secrets of the K'areshi.

The Elite Death Knight is a temporary PvP title earned for reaching a PvP rating of 2300+. The title itself is rewarded by achievements for the associated season. However, this title is considered a "seasonal title" and will be removed at the end of the current season it was obtained in and must be earned once again in the upcoming season to reequip it. It follows the name in the following format: : the Elite Death Knight

The Gnoll Wars is a stone located in a cave in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The First Kurnal is a stone located southeast of Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The First Echo is an exploration achievement earned by completing a single Worldsoul Memory event.
The Giant is a human located in during Nightmare Incursions.
The General's Consensus concludes the Unravelling the Trapped chapter of the Azj-Kahet storyline. The campaign continues immediately with A Most Intriguing Invitation.

"The Goblin Way" is a short story by Andrew Robinson published digitally on the official site on 3 June 2024. It is also part of the anthology The Voices Within. It is illustrated by Ognjen Sporin. It focuses on Monte Gazlowe, the trade prince of the Bilgewater Cartel.
The Fury of the Sunwell: Launch Trailer is the official trailer for Patch 2.5.4: Fury of the Sunwell of World of Warcraft: Burning Crusade Classic.
The Gods of Zul'Aman: Launch Trailer is the official trailer for Patch 2.5.4: The Gods of Zul'Aman of World of Warcraft: Burning Crusade Classic.
.]] The Frenemies Pack was a bundle that included six mounts and five companions, available from the Battle.net Shop. The bundle was available from 18 June 2024 to 1 July 2024.
The General's War Chest is a quest reward from Blade of the General.

The Fleet Arrives begins the max-level storyline of The War Within (achievement). This quest becomes available after completing the leveling campaign and reaching Renown level 4 with the Council of Dornogal, Assembly of the Deeps, Hallowfall Arathi, and Severed Threads. Level 80 alts of players who've previously completed the leveling campaign can pick up A Time to Come Together, which skips the leveling campaign and leads directly into The Fleet Arrives.
The Fury of Stormrage can be found in Felpaw Village in . It contains Rune of Nature Specialization.
The General's Salute is a quest achievement earned by completing the quest The General's Resolve in Azj-Kahet.
The First Eidolon's Soulsteel is the Tier 28 death knight set.
The Flame Burns Within is a reputation achievement earned by reaching rank 25 with the Hallowfall Arathi.
The General's Commendation is automatically consumed and provides the amount of reputation shown in its tooltip with the General.
The General's Trove is a quest reward from The General's Conviction and Notorious with The General.
The Gatecrashers is a world event achievement earned by defeating all of the following world bosses during WoW's Anniversary. * Doomwalker * Archavon the Stonewatcher * Sha of Anger
The Fifth's Linked Treads drop from The Seven in Blackrock Depths.
The Final Toy begins the 7 November step of Guest Relations.
The Fumigator is created with Engineering (300); taught by Schematic: The Fumigator.

The Forgotten Smith is a human blacksmith. He mails the Nightmarish Hitching Post to those who have bought the item from the shops or Trading Post, mentioning it was made from the leftovers used for the Warforged Nightmare.
The G.R.I.D. is the final room of Operation: Floodgate, where the Geezle Gigazap encounter takes place.
The Geargrinder is a siege engine located in Liberation of Undermine.
The Gobfather is a world boss located at Demolition Dome in northern Undermine. Players are tasked with defeating him in the The Main Event world quest.
The G.O.L.E.M. of Progress begins the optional storyline of the same name for Sojourner of Undermine, started by Old Man Lowe in the Vatworks of Undermine, part of the Undermine(d) campaign.

The Flame Burns Eternal is the weekly quest for the Nightfall scenario and the Flame's Radiance at Morgaen's Tears in southwestern Hallowfall. The Nightfall scenario takes place hourly at the top of the hour (at xx:00).

The Freedom of Ray-cing concludes the "Rays of Sunshine" chapter of Otherworldly Ecologist. The second half of this chapter was first made available in the second half of the week of 19 August 2025. The next chapter starts after the weekly reset in the week of 2 September 2025 with Being Spiritual.
The Foolhardy's Guide to Survival can be looted from Brimming Deep-Lost Satchels and Deep-Lost Satchels in the Ringing Deeps.
__NOTOC__ The Fifty Rules of Commerce, Fourth Edition can be looted from Pilfered Loot and Stashed Loot in Azj-Kahet.
The Future of The Fel Hammer starts the Demon Hunter Order Hall Campaign in Legion Remix, allowing the player to choose between Altruis the Sufferer and Kayn Sunfury as their champion.
The Frog and the Princesses is an exploration achievement earned for /kissing all the "princess" frogs throughout Zul'Aman.
The Goblin Cartels Commendation is displayed on quests while a Cartel of Undermine faction hasn't been selected for the week.

.]] The Hallow's End Pack was a bundle that included three mounts and two companions that was available from the Battle.net Shop. The bundle was available from 17 October 2023 to 31 October 2023; afterwards, all items in the bundle were no longer available for purchase.

The Great Push (abbreviated as TGP) is a spinoff of the Mythic Dungeon International (MDI) esports program, introduced on 7 April 2021. While the MDI has teams fighting to beat their opponent's time, The Great Push is focused on teams pushing for the highest Mythic+ run.
The High Speaker's Secret concludes the Dark Revelations chapter of the Ringing Deeps storyline. The campaign continues immediately with Absent Speaker.

The Harbinger begins the prelude storyline, "Hunt for the Harbinger", part of the Dark Heart campaign added in patch 10.2.7. Players will earn the Bow of the Ranger Captain and Arsenal: Voidtouched Weaponry appearances, the Winding Slitherdrake: Void Scales drakewatcher manuscript, and the Hunt the Harbinger achievement as rewards for completing the quest chain.
The Grand Tapestry is a reputation achievement earned by reaching the maximum reputation with the Weaver in Azj-Kahet.
The Grasping Darkness is a mistlurker located in Isaec's Folly in Hallowfall.

The Hidden Zeroth Letter of the Alphabet and Other Mysteries of Linguistic Mathematics is a book tucked away under a shelf in the room past Door 430 in Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario.

The Great Enla is a duck that spawns to attack Clan Aylaag's caravan when the Aylaag Camp moves to a new location on the Ohn'ahran Plains.

The Hole Deal concludes the optional "Fore!" storyline of Sojourner of Undermine, located at the Emerald Hills Golf Course in southeastern Undermine. This quest is repeated in the world quest Boomball (world quest).
